links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT on 48 medical calculation tasks
links.effect: Incorrect responses in one-third of trials (n = 212) for unaugmented ChatGPT.
links.quote: We evaluated ChatGPT's performance across 48 medical calculation tasks, finding incorrect responses in one-third of trials (n = 212).

unlisted_practices: Augmenting LLMs with machine-readable, task-specific calculation tools (OpenMedCalc) or a code interpreter to reduce clinical calculation errors

screen.practice: tool augmentation (task-specific calculators, RAG, code interpreter) for LLM calculations
screen.reason: Empirically tests and compares LLM performance with and without safeguards/deployment augmentations (RAG, code interpreter, and task-specific calculation tools) on clinical calculation tasks.
